text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the JBC Classic, the third
race of
Smart Falcon's victory
declaration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ever since her declaration, Смарт Фалкон
has kept
calm and focused on achieving
victory, but today
she appears strangely
unfocused.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I start to say we should have a serious
talk after
the race, but she cuts me off
with a smile and
heads to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
